All these downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow internally but requests queue before frontend processes them.
CPU usage of frontend is 80% of its 10m CPU limit, indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion.

The 6.5% error rate on frontend->adservice is a symptom of frontend's slowness causing timeouts, not a separate fault.
Therefore, frontend is the root cause with resource exhaustion fault type, propagating latency to all downstream services on the critical path and others.
